standard_prerequisites.name: Almost-Besse contact form
standard_prerequisites.statement: A contact form is almost-Besse when the Reeb field is nowhere tangent to the contact structure and the linearised return map along each closed Reeb orbit has all eigenvalues real.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the hypothesis under which the four conclusions of the statement are derived.

standard_prerequisites.name: Collar coordinates on the boundary
standard_prerequisites.statement: A collar neighbourhood A_C x S^1 of a component C x S^1 of the boundary is identified with [0,rho) x S^1 x S^1, and the solid cylinder Y_1 with B_1 x S^1.
standard_prerequisites.use: They are introduced at the start of the proof at source line 1313 to write the gluing map explicitly.

standard_prerequisites.name: The map tilde-iota and the normalised form
standard_prerequisites.statement: The map tilde-iota(r,s,t) = (r e^{2 pi i (q_0 s - alpha_1' t)}, p_0 s + alpha_1 t) identifies the collar with the cylinder, and tilde-lambda_0 is the displayed normalised contact form.
standard_prerequisites.use: They are used at source lines 1313-1327 to compute the pull-back of nu and the vanishing of omega.

core_obligations: Write the restriction of tilde-iota to the collar A_C x S^1 explicitly in the coordinates (r,s,t), and write tilde-lambda_0 in the same coordinates as the displayed one-form (source lines 1313-1327).

Compute the pull-backs along the collar to obtain the first two conclusions: nu restricted to the boundary equals nu_0 there, and the two-form omega vanishes identically on the boundary (source lines 1328 onwards, closing conclusions (i) and (ii)).
Show that the Reeb field R_{tilde-lambda} of the normalised form extends smoothly to the boundary and is tangent to it, using the explicit form of tilde-lambda_0 in the collar (conclusion (iii)).

Establish the uniform C1-closeness statement: for every epsilon > 0 choose delta > 0 so that whenever the Reeb field R_lambda is C2-close to R_{lambda_0}, the normalised Reeb field is C1-close to the vector field d/dt (conclusion (iv)).

proof_roadmap.step: Set up the collar coordinates and the explicit formulas for tilde-iota and tilde-lambda_0.
Compute the pull-backs giving the boundary behaviour of nu and the vanishing of omega.
Extend the normalised Reeb field to the boundary and derive the C1-estimate.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled lemma `l:nearly_Besse_normalized` at source lines 1289-1310, a four-part statement about the normalisation of an almost-Besse contact form: the pull-back of nu to the boundary agrees with nu_0, the two-form omega vanishes there, the normalised Reeb field extends smoothly and tangentially to the boundary, and it is C1-close to d/dt whenever the original Reeb field is C2-close to R_{lambda_0}. The author's proof (source lines 1312-1401) is a long computation in collar coordinates, not a citation: it first writes the gluing map tilde-iota on a collar A_C x S^1 and the normalised form tilde-lambda_0 explicitly in the coordinates (r,s,t) (lines 1313-1327), and the four conclusions are then read off from pull-back computations along that collar, including the smooth extension of the Reeb field and a quantitative C1-estimate that depends on the C2-closeness hypothesis. The enumeration in the statement hides that the four parts are established by different computations inside one collar chart.
